keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Club Brugge 0, Liverpool 1. Alexander Isak (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Dominik Szoboszlai.
Delay in match because of an injury Víctor Muñoz (Liverpool).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Liverpool. Rio Ngumoha replaces Víctor Muñoz because of an injury.
Second Half begins Club Brugge 0, Liverpool 1.
Delay in match because of an injury Brandon Mechele (Club Brugge).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Joaquin Seys (Club Brugge).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Liverpool. Virgil van Dijk replaces Jeremie Frimpong.
Substitution, Liverpool. Alexis Mac Allister replaces Trey Nyoni.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Romeo Vermant replaces Hugo Vetlesen.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Mamadou Diakhon replaces Félix Lemaréchal.
Goal! Club Brugge 0, Liverpool 2. Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Rio Ngumoha following a fast break.
Goal! Club Brugge 0, Liverpool 3. Alexander Isak (Liverpool) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Alisson Becker following a fast break.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Hugo Siquet replaces Kyriani Sabbe.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Cheveyo Tsawa replaces Freddie Potts.
Substitution, Liverpool. Luke Chambers replaces Bradley Barcola.
Substitution, Liverpool. Lewis Koumas replaces Alexander Isak.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Matteo Dams replaces Joaquin Seys.
Second Half ends, Club Brugge 0, Liverpool 3.
